name: Wild Roses of Prudence Prep
source: High school first year Clover Ipswich is forced to transfer into an unknown boarding school while burdened with more baggage than just the duffel bag slung over her shoulder. Beset upon right away by her irritating new schoolmates, she struggles to adjust to her changing life at the academy while also trying to make sense of the old troubles she never quite left behind.
